card.name: Exposure and single-dose overdose wording
card.fires_on: Words just before an exposure instruction or a dose amount: 'Immediately' or the gap before a number of minutes in wash-off instructions, and 'single' before oral doses in overdose or toxicity text.

modes.label: Single before doses
modes.description: The word 'single' ahead of 'oral dose(s) up to' in overdose or animal toxicity passages.

modes.label: Wash-off instructions
modes.description: The word 'Immediately' or the space before a duration in instructions to rinse eyes or skin after exposure.
modes.example: flush eyes with water for at least<< >>10 minutes.

modes.label: Heat and linking words
modes.description: Words in warnings about heat sources or joining words in risk phrases.
modes.example: such as hair dryers,<< heating>> pads, electric blankets

card.writes: Little clear effect; it may slightly favor words about comfort and disfavor words about damage or repair.
card.plain: It fires on words that lead into a dose amount or a rinse-off instruction, such as 'single' dose or 'immediately' wash.
